author: marcfeuermann
body:
If only it were that simple ! We have here a big family with apparently many gains and losses of function. Only fungal sequences are present in one single copy. We have scramblases AND chloride channels. Moreover, some are none of the two and some others are annotated to both functions. I've tried to make the best evolutionary model possible and cleaned the annotation. 
Cheers,
Marc

author: ValWood
body:
Ah yes, it seems to be both. I wonder if the yeast one is also a chloride channel in that case. But probably best not to infer since the  function is not always present.
thanks!

author: marcfeuermann
body: Yes indeed, for the moment I've kept only the scramblase activity for fungi :-)
